# .github/PR_LABELS.md

## Purpose

Provide high‑signal, automated **PR labels** for review routing, release hygiene, and search—without introducing `type:*` PR labels.

This file is managed centrally in the LightSpeed WP community health repository.

See the canonical version here:  
[Community Health Repo PR_LABELS.md](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/blob/develop/.github/PR_LABELS.md)

For updates, refer to the community health repo.

## Files powering this

- [.github/labeler.yml](https://github.com/lightspeedwp/.github/blob/develop/.github/labeler.yml) — path & branch rules.
- `.github/workflows/labels-issues-prs.yml` — defaults, status enforcement, changelog nudge.
